api_token.description: The Pushover application API token. Can also be set via the `PUSHOVER_API_TOKEN` environment variable.

block.description: The Pushover provider allows you to send push notifications via [Pushover](https://pushover.net). Configure the provider with your application API token to get started.

device.description: Optionally restrict notifications to a specific device for this user.

disabled.description: Set to `true` to disable notifications to this user without removing them from the group.

id.description: Unique identifier for this group membership (`group_key/user_key[/device]`).

memo.description: An optional note about this group member (up to 200 characters).

user_key.description: The Pushover user key to add to the group.

block.description: Adds a user to a Pushover delivery group. The group must already exist in Pushover. The group key is typically obtained from the Pushover dashboard or from a `pushover_group` resource.

api_token.description: Override the provider-level Pushover application API token for this message.

callback.description: A URL to ping when an emergency message has been acknowledged.

device.description: The name of a specific device to deliver the message to, rather than all of the user's devices.

expire.description: How long (in seconds) to continue re-sending an emergency message. Required when `priority` is `2`. Maximum: 10800.

html.description: Set to `true` to enable HTML formatting in the message body.

message.description: The message body (up to 1024 characters). Supports HTML if `html` is enabled.

monospace.description: Set to `true` to display the message in a monospace font.

receipt.description: Receipt token returned for emergency (`priority = 2`) messages. Use `pushover_receipt` data source to poll delivery status.

request_id.description: The unique request ID returned by the Pushover API.

retry.description: How often (in seconds) to re-send an emergency message until acknowledged. Required when `priority` is `2`. Minimum: 30.

sound.description: The name of a Pushover sound to override the user's default. Use the `pushover_sounds` data source to list available sounds.

timestamp.description: A Unix timestamp to display instead of the time the message was received.

title.description: The message title (up to 250 characters). Defaults to the application name.

ttl.description: Time to live in seconds. The message is deleted from Pushover servers after this period.

url.description: A supplementary URL to show with the message (up to 512 characters).

url_title.description: A title for the supplementary URL (up to 100 characters).

user_key.description: The Pushover user or group key to deliver the message to.

block.description: Sends a Pushover notification. The message is delivered when this resource is created. To resend the message (e.g., when content changes), use `terraform taint` or update a trigger via `replace_triggered_by`.

keys.description: A list of available sound keys that can be used in `pushover_message`.

sounds.description: A map of sound key to human-readable sound name.

block.description: Retrieves the list of available Pushover notification sounds. Use the sound keys with the `pushover_message` resource's `sound` attribute.

api_token.description: Override the provider-level API token for this validation.

device.description: Optionally restrict validation to a specific device name.

devices.description: The list of device names registered to this user.

id.description: The validated user key (used as resource identifier).

is_group.description: `true` if the key belongs to a Pushover delivery group.

licenses.description: The list of license types active for this user.

user_key.description: The Pushover user or group key to validate.

block.description: Validates a Pushover user or group key and returns associated device names and license information. Useful for verifying recipient keys before sending notifications.
